note: 'analyst' on its own usually means business analyst (Kyle, Oct 13, 2026: Associate analyst)
'developer' on its own is a software developer
'programmer' on its own is a software developer
'engineer' on its own most often means software; systems and infrastructure are the usual alternatives
a consulting-firm 'consultant' grade is the consultant role; the band comes from the grade word
'architect' on its own usually means solution architect
'administrator' on its own usually means systems administrator
'designer' on its own in a technology contract usually means interaction (UX) designer
'manager' on its own in a technology contract most often means project manager; the pyramid grade 'Manager' is handled by the consulting rule, not here
